nonblocking_findings: Budget-gate vs falsifying region interaction: TOTAL_GET_CEILING (3200) is enforced only post-hoc as V5, and the cycle admission rule in the frozen module checks wall-clock but not the GET ledger. For a low-sharing (falsifying-shaped) population, K ~ 0.95*cold ~ 880 makes three completed cycles cost ~3300-3900 GETs, so whenever mean per-GET latency p <= ~0.13 s all three cycles complete and the post-hoc V5 gate would convert a would-be FALSIFIES (or a high-K MIXED with K > ~750 at cold=926) into MEASUREMENT_INVALID; at p > ~0.30 s with cold=926 no cycle completes and the run is INCONCLUSIVE. FALSIFIES is therefore recordable in the attainable window p ~ 0.13-0.30 s (inside the DESIGN-measured 0.02-0.36 s range), and the spec's expected regime (sharing factor ~4, K ~ 200) has ample headroom (~1550 GETs). This is a pre-registered invalid branch, not a mislabeling risk, but under the mandate's 'second invalid parks the thread' rule it is the single most likely way this funded attempt ends unanswered; EXECUTE should record the ledger-vs-admission arithmetic explicitly if V5 fires.

SUPPORTS is population-conditional, not generically reachable: because admission requires hop >= 3, mean_path >= 4 always, so A_w can only pay when 0.9*cold/N >= 4, i.e. N <= 0.225*cold (<= ~208 at cold=926). On a deeper/wider live stratum SUPPORTS becomes structurally impossible and the label set reduces to MIXED/FALSIFIES. This is consistent with the disclosed tilt (H2 expects A to fail) and does not empty the positive decision-changing branch (MIXED is robustly reachable), but the spec's claim that SUPPORTS is a reachable state of the world should be read under this precondition.

The per-cycle cost rows are cycle-invariant by construction (mean_path, K, sum|path| and cold are all census-fixed), so 'pays at every measured cycle' is effectively a single 2-bit comparison repeated; the three cycles carry the invalidation/hazard information, not the cost decision. Spec and prereg disclose this ('cross-cycle disagreement sub-state ... cannot be produced by a frozen store page set'), so it is an audit-clarity note, not an identifiability defect.

Wording/implementation mismatch: spec.json's B-COLD-BATCH-CRAWL definition says 'one cold frozen-policy crawl per host per cycle' while the module measures cold once (at census) and reuses it for every cycle; prereg §17 discloses the one-shot estimate. The label cannot change (cold is cycle-invariant), but AUDIT should compare against the prereg text, not the spec baseline phrase.

Gate-key naming mismatch inside the frozen module: metrics['gates'] uses keys 'V4_budget' and 'V10_envelope', whereas prereg §12 defines V5 = budget and V8 = envelope, and prereg V10 is the live change-detector gate (reported separately as M-LIVE-POS-CHANGE). Cosmetic only - all quantities are computed identically - but a downstream AUDIT reading gate keys literally could mislabel the invalid signature.

research/lanes/registry.json (repo_root() locator) and codex/legacy_brief.json (legacy-disposition narrative) are not in spec.freeze_artifacts. Neither can alter the decision partition: the first only affects the two covariate reference loads (silently empty if unresolved, visible in M-CENSUS-OVERLAP-PARENT208/M-COLD-BATCH-REF-STRUCT), the second supports narrative classification only.

rationale: The design is capable of answering its own question and no check fails. Independent evidence gathered at review: (1) the frozen module's identity was re-pinned by recomputing sha256 over the stripped FROZEN_CODE block (exact match to DERIVED_SHA256); (2) the 15/15 offline fixture controls and all five decision canaries were re-executed under that exact code; (3) all four bound seeds and all five control URLs were probed live (seeds 200, 3/3 positive controls changed within 8 s, 2/2 nulls stable); (4) all ten freeze artifacts exist with hash prefixes matching prereg §15; (5) an independent synthetic two-host end-to-end run of the exact frozen module produced a non-null decision (MIXED) with exact GET-ledger reconciliation, populated hazard bound and tau ladder, zero-cost endpoint ablation, and all gates passing, plus the pre-registered abort paths; (6) static arithmetic established that the SUPPORTS and FALSIFIES regions are nonempty, thresholds are attainable (0.9*926 = 833.4 exactly), and A-implies-B holds, while also quantifying the one real reachability caveat: the post-hoc V5 budget gate can convert a falsifying-shaped population into MEASUREMENT_INVALID when three cycles complete at p <= ~0.13 s per GET. The harness envelope assumed by V8 (1200 s default) was confirmed in the workflow scripts. The experiment's expected regime sits far below every ceiling; the residual risks are population- or latency-conditional, pre-registered as invalid (never as negatives), and are recorded as nonblocking findings for EXECUTE/AUDIT. No confirmatory measurement was run, no frame page was crawled, and no frozen threshold was tuned: spec/prereg are unedited.
